oil.when: 2003 trucks with the Driver Information Center (fuel information and select buttons)
steps: Reset only after the engine oil and filter have actually been changed.
Turn the ignition on.
Press the fuel information button repeatedly until ENGINE OIL LIFE shows in the display.
While ENGINE OIL LIFE is showing, press and hold the select button until the reading goes back to 100%.
oil.note: The oil life reading does not measure how much oil is in the engine, so keep checking the dipstick between changes.

steps: Reset only after the engine oil and filter have actually been changed.
Turn the key to RUN with the engine off.
Push the accelerator pedal all the way down and let it up, three times within five seconds.
OIL LIFE RESET should show for about 10 seconds while the system resets.
Turn the key to LOCK. If CHANGE ENGINE OIL comes back on at the next start, repeat the steps; if it still will not clear, have a dealer look at it.

oil.when: 2010–2013, accelerator pedal method (works on every truck)
steps: Reset only after the engine oil and filter have actually been changed.
Turn the ignition to ON/RUN with the engine off.
Slowly push the accelerator pedal all the way to the floor three times within five seconds.
Bring up OIL LIFE REMAINING on the Driver Information Center. If it reads 100%, the reset worked.
If CHANGE ENGINE OIL SOON comes back when you start the truck, or oil life still reads near 0%, repeat the steps.
oil.note: Checked in the 2010 and 2013 owner's manuals.

oil.when: 2010 using the Driver Information Center buttons or the trip odometer stem
steps: Reset only after the engine oil and filter have actually been changed.
Bring up OIL LIFE REMAINING on the Driver Information Center. On a truck without DIC buttons, shift to Park first and use the trip odometer reset stem to reach it.
Press and hold the SET/RESET button (or the trip odometer stem on trucks without DIC buttons) for more than five seconds.
Let go when the oil life reads 100%. If CHANGE ENGINE OIL SOON comes back at the next start, repeat the steps.

oil.when: 2014 (Driver Information Center button or accelerator pedal)
steps: Reset only after the engine oil and filter have actually been changed.
Turn the ignition to ON/RUN with the engine off.
Bring up OIL LIFE REMAINING on the Driver Information Center, then press and hold the select (checkmark) button for more than five seconds until it reads 100%.
If you cannot reach the display, slowly push the accelerator pedal all the way down three times within five seconds instead, then check that OIL LIFE REMAINING reads 100%.
If CHANGE ENGINE OIL SOON comes back at the next start, or oil life stays near 0%, repeat the steps.

notes: The oil life system does not reset itself, so reset it after every oil change, even an early one. If it is reset by mistake, change the oil within about 3,000 miles of the last change.
